summary: This bill amends the National Security Act of 1947 to require the Director of National Intelligence to produce and submit to Congress periodic intelligence assessments on the national and economic security effects of climate change, with the first assessment due four years after enactment and subsequent assessments every six years.

scores.thoughts: This bill directs the Director of National Intelligence to produce assessments on the national security effects of climate change. While it doesn't directly allocate or reduce military spending, it mandates intelligence activities related to national security, which falls under the broader umbrella of defense. The impact is indirect and focused on intelligence gathering rather than direct military operations or procurement.
